English Question: What is the highest mountain in the world?
Nepali Question: विश्वको सबैभन्दा अग्लो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Mount Everest, on the Nepal-China border, is the world's highest peak above sea level.
Source Title: Survey Department of Nepal – Peak Heights
Notes: verified

English Question: How many mountains above 8,000 meters are located in Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा ८,००० मिटरभन्दा माथिका कति हिमालहरू छन्?
Explanation: Nepal contains eight of the world's fourteen peaks above 8,000 meters.
Notes: verified

English Question: How many provinces does Nepal have?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा कति प्रदेश छन्?
Explanation: Nepal was restructured into 7 provinces under the federal system established by the Constitution of Nepal (2015), Article 56 and Schedule 4.
Source Title: Constitution of Nepal - Nepal Law Commission
Notes: verified

English Question: Which river gorge in Nepal is considered one of the deepest gorges in the world?
Nepali Question: नेपालको कुन नदी उपत्यका विश्वकै गहिरो उपत्यकामध्ये एक मानिन्छ?
Explanation: The Kali Gandaki Gorge, between the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna massifs, is among the world's deepest river gorges.
Notes: verified

English Question: Which province was formerly known as Province No. 1 before being officially named?
Nepali Question: पहिले 'प्रदेश नं. १' भनिने प्रदेशलाई पछि आधिकारिक रूपमा के नाम दिइयो?
Explanation: Province No. 1 was officially renamed Koshi Province on 1 March 2023 by vote of the Provincial Assembly, after the Koshi River.
Source Title: Kathmandu Post - Province 1 named Koshi (1 Mar 2023)
Notes: verified

English Question: Which national park in Nepal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for rhinoceros and tigers?
Nepali Question: गैंडा र बाघका लागि प्रसिद्ध नेपालको कुन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदा सूचीमा छ?
Explanation: Chitwan National Park was gazetted in 1973 under the National Parks and Wildlife Conservation Act and inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984 (Ref. no. 284).
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Chitwan National Park (C284)
Notes: verified

English Question: What is the name of Nepal's first and largest conservation area, covering the Annapurna range?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण क्षेत्र समेट्ने नेपालको पहिलो र सबैभन्दा ठूलो संरक्षण क्षेत्रको नाम के हो?
Explanation: The Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP) began as a pilot in Ghandruk in 1986 and was officially gazetted as the Annapurna Conservation Area in 1992; it remains Nepal's largest protected area, managed under a community-based model by the National Trust for Nature Conservation.
Source Title: National Trust for Nature Conservation – ACAP
Notes: verified

English Question: In which city is Swayambhunath Stupa located?
Nepali Question: स्वयम्भूनाथ स्तूप कुन शहरमा अवस्थित छ?
Explanation: Swayambhunath, also called the Monkey Temple, sits atop a hill in the Kathmandu Valley.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List – Kathmandu Valley
Notes: verified

English Question: Which high-altitude pass connects the Annapurna Circuit's Manang and Mustang districts?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण सर्किटमा मनाङ र मुस्ताङ जिल्लालाई जोड्ने उच्च-उचाइको पास कुन हो?
Explanation: At 5,416 meters, Thorong La is one of the highest trekking passes in the world and a key point on the Annapurna Circuit.
Source Title: Nepal Tourism Board – Annapurna Circuit Route Guide
Notes: verified

English Question: Which lake in Pokhara is the second-largest lake in Nepal?
Nepali Question: पोखराको कुन ताल नेपालको दोस्रो ठूलो ताल हो?
Explanation: Phewa Lake in Pokhara is Nepal's second-largest lake and a major tourist attraction.
Source Title: Survey Department of Nepal – Lakes of Nepal
Notes: verified

English Question: Which UNESCO World Heritage Site in Nepal is recognized as the birthplace of Gautam Buddha?
Nepali Question: नेपालको कुन युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदा स्थल गौतम बुद्धको जन्मस्थलको रूपमा मान्यता प्राप्त छ?
Explanation: Lumbini, in Rupandehi district, is recognized by UNESCO as the birthplace of Siddhartha Gautam Buddha.
Notes: verified

English Question: Which two countries share a border with Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालसँग कुन दुई देशहरूको सीमा जोडिएको छ?
Explanation: Nepal is a landlocked country bordered by China to the north (a border of about 1,414 km per Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs) and India to the south, east, and west.
Source Title: Nepal-China Relations - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Nepal
Notes: verified

English Question: Which national park holds the largest population of the greater one-horned rhinoceros in Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा एक सिङ्गे गैंडाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो जनसंख्या कुन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्जमा छ?
Explanation: Per the Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation, Chitwan National Park and its surrounding forest hold 605 greater one-horned rhinos, more than any other protected area in Nepal (Bardia: 29; Shuklaphanta: 8; Parsa: 3).
Notes: verified

English Question: What is the officially surveyed elevation of Mount Everest as jointly announced by Nepal and China in 2020?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२० मा नेपाल र चीनले संयुक्त रूपमा घोषणा गरेको माउन्ट एभरेष्टको आधिकारिक उचाइ कति हो?
Explanation: In 2020, Nepal and China jointly announced a revised official height of 8,848.86 meters for Mount Everest.
Source Title: Survey Department of Nepal – Everest Height Announcement 2020
Notes: verified

English Question: Which mountain is the third-highest peak in the world, located on the Nepal-India (Sikkim) border?
Nepali Question: विश्वको तेस्रो अग्लो हिमाल, जुन नेपाल-भारत (सिक्किम) सीमामा अवस्थित छ, कुन हो?
Explanation: At 8,586 m, Kanchenjunga is the world's third-highest mountain and straddles the border of Nepal's Koshi Province and India's Sikkim state.

English Question: Which mountain, connected to Mount Everest by the South Col, is the fourth-highest peak in the world?
Nepali Question: दक्षिण कोलमार्फत माउन्ट एभरेष्टसँग जोडिएको, विश्वको चौथो अग्लो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Lhotse, 8,516 m, is directly connected to Everest via the South Col and is the world's fourth-highest mountain.

English Question: Which mountain near Mount Everest is the fifth-highest peak in the world?
Nepali Question: माउन्ट एभरेष्ट नजिकैको, विश्वको पाँचौं अग्लो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Makalu, 8,485 m, lies about 19 km southeast of Everest and is the world's fifth-highest mountain.

English Question: Which eight-thousander lies on the Nepal-China border west of Mount Everest and is the sixth-highest mountain in the world?
Nepali Question: माउन्ट एभरेष्टको पश्चिममा नेपाल-चीन सीमामा रहेको, विश्वको छैटौं अग्लो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Cho Oyu, 8,188 m, sits on the Nepal-China border and is the world's sixth-highest mountain.

English Question: Which mountain, whose Nepali name means 'White Mountain,' is the seventh-highest peak in the world?
Nepali Question: सेतो हिमाल' भन्ने अर्थ बोक्ने, विश्वको सातौं अग्लो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Dhaulagiri, 8,167 m, located in west-central Nepal, is the world's seventh-highest mountain; the name derives from Sanskrit for 'dazzling, white mountain.'

English Question: Which mountain, sometimes called 'Mountain of the Spirit,' is the eighth-highest peak in the world?
Nepali Question: कहिलेकाहीं 'आत्माको हिमाल' भनिने, विश्वको आठौं अग्लो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Manaslu, 8,163 m, located in the Gandaki region, is the world's eighth-highest mountain; its name derives from the Sanskrit 'manasa' (soul/spirit).

English Question: Which mountain became the first peak above 8,000 meters ever successfully climbed, in 1950?
Nepali Question: सन् १९५० मा पहिलोपटक सफलतापूर्वक आरोहण गरिएको ८,००० मिटरभन्दा माथिको पहिलो हिमाल कुन हो?
Explanation: Annapurna I (8,091 m) was first summited on 3 June 1950 by Maurice Herzog and Louis Lachenal of a French expedition, making it the first eight-thousander ever climbed.
Source Title: Cross-checked: multiple independent mountaineering history sources

English Question: What is the capital of Koshi Province?
Nepali Question: कोशी प्रदेशको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Biratnagar serves as the capital and largest city of Koshi Province (formerly Province No. 1).
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: What is the capital of Madhesh Province?
Nepali Question: मधेश प्रदेशको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Janakpur is the capital of Madhesh Province (formerly Province No. 2) and is also a major Hindu pilgrimage city.
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: What is the capital of Bagmati Province?
Nepali Question: बागमती प्रदेशको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Hetauda is the designated capital of Bagmati Province, although Kathmandu (also within the province) is Nepal's national capital.
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: What is the capital of Gandaki Province?
Nepali Question: गण्डकी प्रदेशको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Pokhara is the capital of Gandaki Province and one of Nepal's most visited tourist cities.
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: What is the designated capital of Lumbini Province?
Nepali Question: लुम्बिनी प्रदेशको तोकिएको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Deukhuri, in Dang district, is the planned/designated capital of Lumbini Province, though Butwal functions as its major administrative and commercial hub.
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: What is the capital of Karnali Province?
Nepali Question: कर्णाली प्रदेशको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Birendranagar, in Surkhet district, is the capital of Karnali Province, Nepal's largest province by area.
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: What is the capital of Sudurpashchim Province?
Nepali Question: सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेशको राजधानी के हो?
Explanation: Godawari, in Kailali district, is the capital of Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal's westernmost province.
Source Title: Nepal Provincial Capitals - Govt. records via Wikipedia list of capitals

English Question: How many districts does Nepal have in total?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा कुल कति जिल्ला छन्?
Explanation: Nepal is divided into 77 districts distributed across its 7 provinces.
Source Title: Districts of Nepal - Govt. structure via Wikipedia list of districts

English Question: How many districts are in Koshi Province?
Nepali Question: कोशी प्रदेशमा कति जिल्ला छन्?
Explanation: Koshi Province comprises 14 districts, the highest number of any province in Nepal.
Source Title: Districts of Koshi Province - Wikipedia list of monuments in Koshi (district enumeration)

English Question: Which river is the longest in Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सबैभन्दा लामो नदी कुन हो?
Explanation: The Karnali River, at approximately 1,080 km, is Nepal's longest river; it becomes the Ghaghara River after entering India.

English Question: Which major river system of eastern Nepal is formed by the confluence of seven tributaries and is called 'Sapta Koshi'?
Nepali Question: पूर्वी नेपालको कुन प्रमुख नदी प्रणाली सात सहायक नदीहरूको संगमबाट बनेको छ र 'सप्तकोशी' भनिन्छ?
Explanation: The Koshi (Sapta Koshi) is formed by seven tributaries -Tamor, Arun, Dudh Koshi, Likhu, Tamakoshi, Sunkoshi, and Indravati- and has Nepal's largest river basin.

English Question: Which river system's basin contains three of the world's eight-thousand-meter peaks (Dhaulagiri, Manaslu, and Annapurna)?
Nepali Question: विश्वका आठ हजार मिटर अग्ला तीनवटा हिमाल (धौलागिरी, मनास्लु, र अन्नपूर्ण) समेट्ने खानीबेसिन कुन नदी प्रणालीको हो?
Explanation: The Gandaki river system's catchment includes Dhaulagiri, Manaslu, and Annapurna I, and it is known as Nepal's deepest river system due to the Kali Gandaki Gorge.

English Question: Which river, considered sacred by Hindus, flows past Pashupatinath Temple in Kathmandu?
Nepali Question: हिन्दुहरूले पवित्र मान्ने कुन नदी काठमाडौंको पशुपतिनाथ मन्दिर हुँदै बग्छ?
Explanation: The Bagmati River flows through Kathmandu Valley and is considered sacred, with Pashupatinath Temple situated on its banks.

English Question: Which is the largest lake in Nepal, located in Mugu District?
Nepali Question: मुगु जिल्लामा अवस्थित नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो ताल कुन हो?
Explanation: Rara Lake, within Rara National Park in Mugu District, is Nepal's largest lake by surface area.

English Question: Which lake in Manang district, at about 4,919 meters, is considered one of the highest lakes in the world?
Nepali Question: मनाङ जिल्लामा करिब ४,९१९ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको, विश्वकै अग्लो तालहरूमध्ये एक मानिने ताल कुन हो?
Explanation: Tilicho Lake, at approximately 4,919 m in Manang district, is widely cited as one of the highest lakes of its size in the world.

English Question: In which city is Kathmandu Durbar Square, a UNESCO-listed monument zone, located?
Nepali Question: युनेस्कोमा सूचीकृत काठमाडौं दरबार क्षेत्र कुन शहरमा अवस्थित छ?
Explanation: Kathmandu Durbar Square (Hanuman Dhoka) is one of seven monument zones comprising the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Kathmandu Valley

English Question: In which city is Patan Durbar Square, one of the Kathmandu Valley's UNESCO monument zones, located?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको युनेस्को स्मारक क्षेत्रमध्ये एक, पाटन दरबार क्षेत्र कुन शहरमा अवस्थित छ?
Explanation: Patan Durbar Square is located in Lalitpur, formerly the capital of the ancient Malla kingdom of Patan.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Kathmandu Valley

English Question: In which city is Bhaktapur Durbar Square, one of the Kathmandu Valley's UNESCO monument zones, located?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको युनेस्को स्मारक क्षेत्रमध्ये एक, भक्तपुर दरबार क्षेत्र कुन शहरमा अवस्थित छ?
Explanation: Bhaktapur Durbar Square lies in the city of Bhaktapur, once capital of the Malla kingdom of Bhaktapur.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Kathmandu Valley

English Question: Which large stupa in Kathmandu, one of the biggest in the world, is part of the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO site?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको कुन ठूलो स्तूप, विश्वकै ठूला स्तूपहरूमध्ये एक, काठमाडौं उपत्यका युनेस्को क्षेत्रको भाग हो?
Explanation: Boudhanath Stupa is one of the world's largest stupas and a monument zone within the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Kathmandu Valley

English Question: Which temple on the banks of the Bagmati River is one of the holiest Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Shiva?
Nepali Question: बागमती नदीको किनारमा रहेको, भगवान शिवलाई समर्पित सबैभन्दा पवित्र हिन्दू मन्दिरहरूमध्ये एक कुन हो?
Explanation: Pashupatinath Temple, on the banks of the Bagmati River in Kathmandu, is one of the most sacred Hindu temples in the world and part of the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO site.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Kathmandu Valley

English Question: Which is considered the oldest Hindu temple in the Kathmandu Valley, dedicated to Lord Vishnu?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको सबैभन्दा पुरानो मानिने, भगवान विष्णुलाई समर्पित हिन्दू मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Changu Narayan Temple, dedicated to Vishnu, is considered the oldest Hindu temple in the Kathmandu Valley and is part of the UNESCO-listed monument zones.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage List - Kathmandu Valley

English Question: How many UNESCO World Heritage Sites does Nepal have in total?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा कुल कति युनेस्को विश्व सम्पदा स्थलहरू छन्?
Explanation: Nepal has four UNESCO World Heritage Sites: two cultural (Kathmandu Valley, Lumbini) and two natural (Chitwan National Park, Sagarmatha National Park).

English Question: Which was the first national park established in Nepal, in 1973?
Nepali Question: सन् १९७३ मा स्थापना भएको नेपालको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Chitwan National Park, gazetted in 1973, was Nepal's first national park.

English Question: Which national park, established in 1976, was Nepal's first national park in the Himalayan mountain region?
Nepali Question: सन् १९७६ मा स्थापना भएको, हिमाली क्षेत्रमा नेपालको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Langtang National Park, established in 1976, was Nepal's first national park located in the Himalayan mountain region.

English Question: In which year was Sagarmatha National Park, home to Mount Everest, established?
Nepali Question: माउन्ट एभरेष्ट रहेको सगरमाथा राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन सालमा स्थापना भएको थियो?
Explanation: Sagarmatha National Park was established on 19 July 1976 and inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1979.

English Question: Which national park in Nepal's Terai region is known for Bengal tigers and wild elephants and is the largest park in the Terai?
Nepali Question: नेपालको तराई क्षेत्रमा रहेको, बंगाल टाइगर र जंगली हात्तीका लागि प्रसिद्ध सबैभन्दा ठूलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Bardiya National Park is the largest and most undisturbed national park in Nepal's Terai lowlands, known for Bengal tigers, wild elephants, and the Karnali River.

English Question: Which national park, established in 2010, was Nepal's tenth national park and lies in present-day Lumbini Province?
Nepali Question: सन् २०१० मा स्थापना भएको, नेपालको दशौं राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज र हालको लुम्बिनी प्रदेशमा रहेको निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Banke National Park, established on 12 July 2010, became Nepal's tenth national park and is located in what is now Lumbini Province.

English Question: How many national parks does Nepal currently have, according to the Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज तथा वन्यजन्तु संरक्षण विभागका अनुसार नेपालमा हाल कति राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्जहरू छन्?
Explanation: Per DNPWC, Nepal's protected area system currently includes 12 national parks, alongside 1 wildlife reserve, 1 hunting reserve, and 6 conservation areas.

English Question: Which is the smallest national park in Nepal, surrounding Rara Lake?
Nepali Question: रारा तालको वरिपरि रहेको, नेपालको सबैभन्दा सानो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Rara National Park, established around Rara Lake in Mugu district, is the smallest national park in Nepal by area.

English Question: How many conservation areas does Nepal currently have, according to DNPWC?
Nepali Question: राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज तथा वन्यजन्तु संरक्षण विभागका अनुसार नेपालमा हाल कति संरक्षण क्षेत्रहरू छन्?
Explanation: Per DNPWC, Nepal currently has 6 conservation areas within its protected area network.

English Question: Which conservation area, established in 2010 around the Api and Nampa peaks, protects far-western Nepal's biodiversity?
Nepali Question: सन् २०१० मा एपी र नाम्पा हिमालको वरिपरि स्थापना भएको, सुदूरपश्चिम नेपालको जैविक विविधता संरक्षण गर्ने संरक्षण क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: The Api Nampa Conservation Area, established in 2010 and covering about 1,903 sq km, protects the region around the Api and Nampa peaks in far-western Nepal.

English Question: Which conservation area in eastern Nepal protects the region around the world's third-highest mountain?
Nepali Question: पूर्वी नेपालमा विश्वको तेस्रो अग्लो हिमाल वरपरको क्षेत्र संरक्षण गर्ने संरक्षण क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: The Kanchenjunga Conservation Area, in Taplejung district, protects the biodiversity of the region surrounding Mount Kanchenjunga.

English Question: Which conservation area protects the region around the world's eighth-highest mountain, connecting to the Annapurna Conservation Area?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण संरक्षण क्षेत्रसँग जोडिने, विश्वको आठौं अग्लो हिमाल वरपरको क्षेत्र संरक्षण गर्ने संरक्षण क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: The Manaslu Conservation Area protects the biodiversity around Mount Manaslu and links ecologically with the Annapurna Conservation Area.

English Question: What is the name of Nepal's only hunting reserve?
Nepali Question: नेपालको एकमात्र आखेट आरक्षको नाम के हो?
Explanation: Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve is Nepal's only hunting reserve, established to allow regulated trophy hunting of species like the blue sheep.

English Question: Which wildlife reserve in eastern Nepal, a Ramsar wetland site, is known for protecting the wild water buffalo (Arna)?
Nepali Question: पूर्वी नेपालमा रहेको, जंगली भैंसी (अर्ना) संरक्षणका लागि प्रसिद्ध र रामसार सूचीमा परेको वन्यजन्तु आरक्ष कुन हो?
Explanation: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve, a Ramsar-listed wetland, is Nepal's key protected area for the wild water buffalo (Arna).

English Question: How many Ramsar Sites (wetlands of international importance) does Nepal have?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा कति रामसार क्षेत्रहरू (अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय महत्वका सिमसार क्षेत्रहरू) छन्?
Explanation: Nepal has ten designated Ramsar Sites, wetlands recognized under the Ramsar Convention for their international ecological importance.
Source Title: Cross-checked: multiple independent sources on Nepal's Ramsar sites

English Question: From which town do most trekkers begin the Everest Base Camp trek after flying in?
Nepali Question: अधिकांश ट्रेकरहरूले हवाइजहाजबाट उडेर आइपुगेपछि एभरेष्ट बेस क्याम्प ट्रेक कुन शहरबाट सुरु गर्छन्?
Explanation: Lukla, home to Tenzing-Hillary Airport, is the standard starting point for the Everest Base Camp trek.

English Question: The Annapurna Base Camp trek ends inside which natural amphitheater surrounded by peaks?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण बेस क्याम्प ट्रेक हिमालहरूले घेरिएको कुन प्राकृतिक रंगशाला (एम्फिथिएटर) भित्र समाप्त हुन्छ?
Explanation: The Annapurna Base Camp trek culminates in the Annapurna Sanctuary, a natural amphitheater ringed by peaks including Annapurna I and Machhapuchhre.

English Question: Which popular viewpoint near Everest Base Camp, at about 5,644 meters, offers a close view of Mount Everest's summit?
Nepali Question: एभरेष्ट बेस क्याम्प नजिकैको, करिब ५,६४४ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको र माउन्ट एभरेष्टको टुप्पो नजिकबाट देखिने लोकप्रिय दृश्यावलोकन स्थल कुन हो?
Explanation: Kala Patthar, at approximately 5,644 m, is a popular viewpoint near Everest Base Camp offering close-up views of Everest's summit.

English Question: Which restricted trekking region in Mustang district, the former Kingdom of Lo, has Lo Manthang as its capital?
Nepali Question: मुस्ताङ जिल्लाको, पूर्व लो राज्य रहेको र लो मन्थाङ राजधानी भएको प्रतिबन्धित ट्रेकिङ क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: Upper Mustang, a restricted trekking area requiring a special permit, was once the independent Kingdom of Lo, with Lo Manthang as its walled capital.

English Question: The Manaslu Circuit trek crosses which high pass at approximately 5,106 meters?
Nepali Question: मनास्लु सर्किट ट्रेकले करिब ५,१०६ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको कुन उच्च पास पार गर्छ?
Explanation: The Manaslu Circuit trek crosses Larkya La Pass, at approximately 5,106 m, connecting the Manaslu and Annapurna regions.

English Question: Which airport in Kathmandu is Nepal's main and longest-serving international airport?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको कुन विमानस्थल नेपालको मुख्य र सबैभन्दा लामो समयदेखि सञ्चालित अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थल हो?
Explanation: Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu has long been Nepal's sole and main international gateway.

English Question: Which international airport, opened in 2022 near Bhairahawa, serves pilgrims visiting Lumbini?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२२ मा भैरहवा नजिकै खुलेको, लुम्बिनी दर्शन गर्न आउने तीर्थयात्रीहरूलाई सेवा दिने अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थल कुन हो?
Explanation: Gautam Buddha International Airport, near Bhairahawa, opened in 2022 to serve pilgrims and tourists visiting nearby Lumbini.

English Question: Which city's international airport opened in 2023, becoming Nepal's third international airport?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२३ मा खुलेको र नेपालको तेस्रो अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थल बनेको सहरको विमानस्थल कुन हो?
Explanation: Pokhara International Airport opened in January 2023, becoming Nepal's third international airport after Kathmandu and Bhairahawa.

English Question: Nepal is divided into which three main physiographic (geographic) regions, from south to north?
Nepali Question: नेपाल दक्षिणदेखि उत्तरसम्म कुन तीन मुख्य भौगोलिक क्षेत्रहरूमा विभाजित छ?
Explanation: Nepal is commonly divided into three physiographic regions from south to north: the Terai lowlands, the Hill (Pahad) region, and the Himalaya (Himal) region.

English Question: What is the total area of Nepal in square kilometers?
Nepali Question: नेपालको कुल क्षेत्रफल कति वर्ग किलोमिटर छ?
Explanation: Nepal covers a total area of approximately 147,181 square kilometers.

English Question: What was Nepal's total population according to the 2021 national census?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२१ को राष्ट्रिय जनगणनाअनुसार नेपालको कुल जनसंख्या कति थियो?
Explanation: According to the 2021 Nepal census conducted by the Central Bureau of Statistics, Nepal's total population was 29,164,578.
Source Title: 2021 Nepal Census - Central Bureau of Statistics

English Question: Which district of Nepal, located in Karnali Province, is the largest by area?
Nepali Question: कर्णाली प्रदेशमा रहेको, क्षेत्रफलका हिसाबले नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो जिल्ला कुन हो?
Explanation: Dolpa District, in Karnali Province, is Nepal's largest district by land area.

English Question: Which is the deepest lake in Nepal, located in Dolpa district at about 3,611 meters?
Nepali Question: डोल्पा जिल्लामा करिब ३,६११ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको नेपालको सबैभन्दा गहिरो ताल कुन हो?
Explanation: Shey Phoksundo Lake, at 3,611 m in Dolpa district, has a maximum recorded depth of about 145 m, making it Nepal's deepest lake.

English Question: Which is the largest national park in Nepal, covering about 3,555 sq km in the trans-Himalayan Dolpa region?
Nepali Question: डोल्पा क्षेत्रको ट्रान्स-हिमालयी भूभागमा फैलिएको, करिब ३,५५५ वर्ग किमी क्षेत्रफल भएको नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Shey Phoksundo National Park, at approximately 3,555 sq km, is Nepal's largest national park and its only trans-Himalayan protected area.

English Question: Which sacred mountain in the Annapurna range, known as 'Fishtail,' has never been officially summited out of religious respect?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण श्रृंखलाको कुन पवित्र हिमाल, जुन 'माछापुच्छ्रे' भनिन्छ, धार्मिक कारणले आधिकारिक रूपमा कहिल्यै आरोहण गरिएको छैन?
Explanation: Machhapuchhre, 6,993 m, is considered sacred to Lord Shiva and has never been officially summited; Nepal does not issue climbing permits for its true peak.

English Question: Which is the longest highway in Nepal, running through the Terai from Mechinagar to Bhim Datta?
Nepali Question: मेचीनगरदेखि भीमदत्तसम्म तराई हुँदै गुज्रिने, नेपालको सबैभन्दा लामो राजमार्ग कुन हो?
Explanation: The Mahendra Highway, also called the East-West Highway, runs approximately 1,027.67 km across the Terai and is Nepal's longest highway.

English Question: Which highway connects Kathmandu to the Nepal-China border at Kodari?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंलाई कोदारीस्थित नेपाल-चीन सीमासँग जोड्ने राजमार्ग कुन हो?
Explanation: The Araniko Highway, about 112 km long, connects Kathmandu to the Nepal-China border at Kodari, passing through Dhulikhel and Barabise.

English Question: Which highway, named after the unifier of Nepal, connects Kathmandu and Pokhara?
Nepali Question: नेपाल एकीकरणकर्ताको नाममा रहेको, काठमाडौं र पोखरालाई जोड्ने राजमार्ग कुन हो?
Explanation: The Prithvi Highway, named after King Prithvi Narayan Shah, is the main road link between Kathmandu and Pokhara.

English Question: Which is Nepal's oldest highway, built in 1956 to connect Kathmandu with Birgunj on the Indian border?
Nepali Question: सन् १९५६ मा निर्मित, काठमाडौंलाई भारतीय सीमास्थित वीरगन्जसँग जोड्ने नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो राजमार्ग कुन हो?
Explanation: The Tribhuvan Highway, completed in 1956 with Indian assistance, is Nepal's oldest highway and connects Kathmandu with Birgunj.

English Question: Which is the third-largest lake in Nepal, located in Kaski district near Pokhara?
Nepali Question: पोखरा नजिकैको कास्की जिल्लामा अवस्थित, नेपालको तेस्रो ठूलो ताल कुन हो?
Explanation: Begnas Lake, in Kaski district, is Nepal's third-largest lake overall and the second-largest among the lakes of Pokhara Valley after Phewa Lake.

English Question: Which temple, sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, sits at about 3,710 meters in Mustang district on the Annapurna Circuit?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण सर्किटमा मुस्ताङ जिल्लामा करिब ३,७१० मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको, हिन्दू र बौद्ध दुवैका लागि पवित्र मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Muktinath, dedicated to Vishnu and known to Buddhists as Chhuming Gyatsa, sits at roughly 3,710 m in Mustang and is sacred to both religions.

English Question: Which wish-fulfilling temple in Gorkha district is reached by Nepal's first cable car, operating since 1998?
Nepali Question: सन् १९९८ देखि सञ्चालनमा रहेको नेपालको पहिलो केबलकारबाट पुगिने, गोर्खा जिल्लाको इच्छापूर्ति गर्ने मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Manakamana Temple, dedicated to Goddess Bhagwati, has been accessible via Nepal's first cable car system (from Kurintar) since November 1998.
Source Title: Nepal Tourism Board - Manakamana Temple, Gorkha

English Question: Which temple in Janakpur, also called Nau Lakha Mandir, is dedicated to Goddess Sita?
Nepali Question: जनकपुरमा रहेको, नौलाखा मन्दिर पनि भनिने, देवी सीतालाई समर्पित मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Janaki Mandir in Janakpur, built in white marble in the early 20th century, is dedicated to Goddess Sita and is also known as Nau Lakha Mandir.

English Question: Which Shakti Peeth temple in Taplejung, known locally as Mukkumlung, sits at about 3,794 meters with views of Kanchenjunga?
Nepali Question: ताप्लेजुङमा रहेको, स्थानीय रूपमा मुक्कुमलुङ भनिने र कञ्चनजङ्घाको दृश्य देखिने करिब ३,७९४ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको शक्तिपीठ मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Pathibhara Devi Temple, at approximately 3,794 m in Taplejung district, is a revered Shakti Peeth known as Mukkumlung to the local Limbu community.

English Question: Which high-altitude sacred lake in Rasuwa district, at 4,380 meters, is believed to have been created by Lord Shiva's trident?
Nepali Question: रसुवा जिल्लामा ४,३८० मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको, भगवान शिवको त्रिशूलले बनाएको भनी विश्वास गरिने पवित्र ताल कुन हो?
Explanation: Gosaikunda, at 4,380 m within Langtang National Park, is a major Hindu-Buddhist pilgrimage lake, especially visited during the Janai Purnima festival.

English Question: Which hilltop Newar heritage town in Tanahun district, at about 1,030 meters, was once a major trading hub between Kathmandu and Pokhara?
Nepali Question: तनहुँ जिल्लाको, करिब १,०३० मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको र काठमाडौं-पोखरा बीचको प्रमुख व्यापार केन्द्र रहेको पहाडी नेवार सांस्कृतिक शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Bandipur, at roughly 1,030 m in Tanahun district, is a well-preserved hilltop Newar town that historically served as a major trading center.

English Question: Which historic hill town in Palpa district, once capital of the Magar kingdom of Tanahun, is famous for Dhaka fabric weaving?
Nepali Question: पाल्पा जिल्लाको, पूर्व तनहुँ मगर राज्यको राजधानी रहेको र ढाका कपडा बुनाइका लागि प्रसिद्ध ऐतिहासिक पहाडी शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Tansen, in Palpa district, was once the capital of the Magar kingdom of Tanahun and remains renowned for traditional Dhaka fabric weaving and Newari architecture.

English Question: Which hill station near Kathmandu is famous as a sunrise viewpoint over the Himalayan range?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं नजिकैको, हिमाली शृंखलामाथिको सूर्योदय दृश्यका लागि प्रसिद्ध पहाडी पर्यटकीय स्थल कुन हो?
Explanation: Nagarkot, near Kathmandu, is a popular hill station known for panoramic sunrise views over the Himalayan range, including Everest on clear days.

English Question: Which hill town in Kavrepalanchok district, along the Araniko Highway, is known for Himalayan views and traditional Newar architecture?
Nepali Question: अरनिको राजमार्गसँगै काभ्रेपलाञ्चोक जिल्लामा रहेको, हिमाली दृश्य र परम्परागत नेवार वास्तुकलाका लागि प्रसिद्ध पहाडी शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Dhulikhel, in Kavrepalanchok district along the Araniko Highway, is known for its Himalayan views and preserved Newar architecture.

English Question: Which hill near Kathmandu is accessible by cable car and offers panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको चारैतिरको दृश्य देखिने र केबलकारबाट पुगिने काठमाडौं नजिकैको पहाड कुन हो?
Explanation: Chandragiri Hills, southwest of Kathmandu, is accessible via cable car and offers panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley and, on clear days, the Himalayan range.

English Question: Which hilltop near Pokhara is a famous viewpoint for sunrise over the Annapurna range and Machhapuchhre?
Nepali Question: पोखरा नजिकैको, अन्नपूर्ण शृंखला र माछापुच्छ्रेमाथिको सूर्योदयका लागि प्रसिद्ध डाँडा कुन हो?
Explanation: Sarangkot, near Pokhara, is a well-known viewpoint for watching sunrise over the Annapurna range and Machhapuchhre.

English Question: Which famous viewpoint in the Annapurna region, reached from Ghorepani village, is known for panoramic sunrise views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण क्षेत्रको, घोरेपानी गाउँबाट पुगिने र धौलागिरि तथा अन्नपूर्णको सूर्योदय दृश्यका लागि प्रसिद्ध डाँडा कुन हो?
Explanation: Poon Hill, near Ghorepani in the Annapurna region, is a famous short-trek viewpoint offering panoramic sunrise views of Dhaulagiri and the Annapurna range.

English Question: Which historic Newar town near Kathmandu, home to Nepal's oldest university, retains preserved medieval architecture and temples?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं नजिकैको, नेपालको सबैभन्दा पुरानो विश्वविद्यालय रहेको र मध्ययुगीन वास्तुकला तथा मन्दिरहरू सुरक्षित रहेको ऐतिहासिक नेवार शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Kirtipur, near Kathmandu, is a historic Newar town known for preserved medieval architecture, temples, and is home to Tribhuvan University.

English Question: Which historic Newar town in Kavrepalanchok district sits at the confluence of two rivers and is known for its Indreshwar Mahadev Temple?
Nepali Question: काभ्रेपलाञ्चोक जिल्लाको, दुई नदीको संगममा रहेको र इन्द्रेश्वर महादेव मन्दिरका लागि प्रसिद्ध ऐतिहासिक नेवार शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Panauti, in Kavrepalanchok district, sits at the confluence of the Punyamati and Roshi rivers and is known for its historic Indreshwar Mahadev Temple.

English Question: Which palace in Gorkha district is associated with King Prithvi Narayan Shah, the unifier of Nepal?
Nepali Question: नेपाल एकीकरणकर्ता राजा पृथ्वीनारायण शाहसँग सम्बन्धित, गोर्खा जिल्लाको दरबार कुन हो?
Explanation: Gorkha Durbar, perched on a hilltop in Gorkha district, is the ancestral palace associated with King Prithvi Narayan Shah, who launched the unification of Nepal from there.

English Question: Which major Kathmandu festival features the chariot procession of the Living Goddess Kumari?
Nepali Question: जीवित देवी कुमारीको रथयात्रा समावेश हुने काठमाडौंको प्रमुख चाड कुन हो?
Explanation: Indra Jatra, celebrated in Kathmandu, features the chariot procession of the Kumari (Living Goddess) alongside masked dances honoring Indra, the god of rain.

English Question: Which Bhaktapur festival, marking the Nepali New Year, involves a large chariot-pulling contest and the erection of a ceremonial pole?
Nepali Question: भक्तपुरको कुन चाडले नेपाली नयाँ वर्षको सुरुवात जनाउँछ र ठूलो रथ तान्ने प्रतियोगिता तथा लिङ्गो उठाउने परम्परा समावेश गर्छ?
Explanation: Bisket Jatra in Bhaktapur marks the Nepali New Year and features a chariot-pulling contest between different parts of the city and the raising of a ceremonial lingo pole.

English Question: Which Patan festival involves pulling a tall wooden chariot of a rain god through the city over several weeks?
Nepali Question: पाटनको कुन चाडमा वर्षाका देवताको अग्लो काठे रथलाई शहरभरि हप्तौंसम्म तानिन्छ?
Explanation: Rato Machhindranath Jatra in Patan involves pulling a tall chariot of the rain deity Rato Machhindranath through the city over several weeks, seeking a good harvest.

English Question: Which Hindu festival, observed mainly by women fasting for marital happiness, is celebrated in the month of Bhadra (Aug-Sep)?
Nepali Question: भाद्र महिनामा मनाइने र मुख्यतः महिलाहरूले वैवाहिक सुखका लागि व्रत बस्ने हिन्दू चाड कुन हो?
Explanation: Teej is a Hindu festival observed primarily by women, who fast and pray for marital happiness and family wellbeing, celebrated in the month of Bhadra.

English Question: Which Kathmandu Valley festival involves a procession of cows (or boys dressed as cows) to honor family members who died in the past year?
Nepali Question: विगत वर्षमा मृत्यु भएका परिवारका सदस्यहरूको सम्झनामा गाई (वा गाईको भेषमा केटाहरू) को शोभायात्रा निकालिने काठमाडौं उपत्यकाको चाड कुन हो?
Explanation: Gai Jatra, celebrated in the Kathmandu Valley, involves a procession of cows or cow-costumed participants to help guide the souls of those who died during the year.

English Question: Which major Hindu festival of lights, involving Laxmi Puja and Bhai Tika, is celebrated across Nepal in October-November?
Nepali Question: अक्टोबर-नोभेम्बरमा नेपालभर मनाइने, लक्ष्मी पूजा र भाइटीका समावेश भएको प्रमुख हिन्दू दीपावली चाड कुन हो?
Explanation: Tihar, Nepal's festival of lights, spans five days including Laxmi Puja and Bhai Tika, and is celebrated across the country in October-November.

English Question: Which Gurung village in the Annapurna region is a popular short-trek destination known for traditional culture and mountain views?
Nepali Question: परम्परागत संस्कृति र हिमाली दृश्यका लागि प्रसिद्ध, अन्नपूर्ण क्षेत्रको लोकप्रिय छोटो ट्रेक गन्तव्य गुरुङ गाउँ कुन हो?
Explanation: Ghandruk, a traditional Gurung village in the Annapurna region, is a popular short-trek destination known for its culture and mountain views.

English Question: Which village in the Annapurna region serves as the base for the sunrise trek up to Poon Hill?
Nepali Question: पून हिल सूर्योदय ट्रेकको आधार बिन्दुको रूपमा रहेको अन्नपूर्ण क्षेत्रको गाउँ कुन हो?
Explanation: Ghorepani, in the Annapurna region, serves as the base village for the popular short trek up to the Poon Hill sunrise viewpoint.

English Question: Which trekking region north of Kathmandu, home to the Hyolmo/Sherpa community, is known as an accessible alternative to Everest and Annapurna treks?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको उत्तरमा रहेको, ह्योल्मो/शेर्पा समुदायको बसोबास रहेको र एभरेष्ट तथा अन्नपूर्ण ट्रेकको सुगम विकल्पको रूपमा चिनिने ट्रेकिङ क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: Helambu, north of Kathmandu, is home to the Hyolmo (Sherpa) community and is known as a relatively accessible trekking region compared to Everest or Annapurna.

English Question: A trek to the base camp of which mountain, in far-eastern Nepal, passes through the Kanchenjunga Conservation Area?
Nepali Question: सुदूरपूर्वी नेपालको कुन हिमालको बेस क्याम्प ट्रेकले कञ्चनजङ्घा संरक्षण क्षेत्र हुँदै जान्छ?
Explanation: The Kanchenjunga Base Camp trek in far-eastern Nepal passes through the Kanchenjunga Conservation Area, approaching the world's third-highest mountain.

English Question: The trek to Nepal's largest lake begins in which remote district of Karnali Province?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सबैभन्दा ठूलो तालसम्म पुग्ने ट्रेक कर्णाली प्रदेशको कुन दुर्गम जिल्लाबाट सुरु हुन्छ?
Explanation: The trek to Rara Lake, Nepal's largest lake, begins in Mugu District, a remote district of Karnali Province.

English Question: Which Buddhist stupa, built by Japanese Buddhist monks on a hilltop above Pokhara, offers panoramic Annapurna views?
Nepali Question: पोखराको डाँडामा जापानी बौद्ध भिक्षुहरूले निर्माण गरेको, अन्नपूर्ण दृश्य देखिने बौद्ध स्तूप कुन हो?
Explanation: The World Peace Pagoda, built by Japanese Buddhist monks on a hill above Phewa Lake in Pokhara, offers panoramic views of the Annapurna range.

English Question: Which waterfall in Pokhara, also called Patale Chhango, disappears underground into a natural tunnel?
Nepali Question: पोखराको कुन जलप्रपात, जसलाई पातालेछाँगो पनि भनिन्छ, प्राकृतिक सुरुङमा भूमिगत भएर बग्छ?
Explanation: Davis Falls, known locally as Patale Chhango, is a waterfall in Pokhara where the Pardi Khola stream disappears underground into a natural tunnel.

English Question: Which limestone cave in Pokhara is one of the largest caves in Nepal and is dedicated to a Hindu deity?
Nepali Question: पोखराको कुन चुनढुङ्गे गुफा नेपालकै सबैभन्दा ठूला गुफाहरूमध्ये एक हो र हिन्दू देवतालाई समर्पित छ?
Explanation: Mahendra Cave, a large limestone cave in Pokhara, is dedicated to Lord Shiva and is one of the most visited caves in the Pokhara Valley.

English Question: Which temple, dedicated to a form of Goddess Durga, is one of the most sacred Hindu sites in Pokhara?
Nepali Question: पोखराको सबैभन्दा पवित्र हिन्दू स्थलहरूमध्ये एक, देवी दुर्गाको स्वरूपलाई समर्पित मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Bindhyabasini Temple, dedicated to Goddess Bhagwati (a form of Durga), is one of the most sacred and oldest Hindu temples in Pokhara.

English Question: Which narrow river gorge running through Pokhara city is popular for its dramatic depth relative to its width?
Nepali Question: पोखरा शहर हुँदै बग्ने, चौडाइको तुलनामा असाधारण गहिराइका लागि प्रसिद्ध साँघुरो नदी उपत्यका कुन हो?
Explanation: The Seti River Gorge cuts through Pokhara city, notable for being extremely deep and narrow-in places only a few meters wide but tens of meters deep.

English Question: Which eastern hill district of Nepal is famous nationwide for its tea gardens?
Nepali Question: नेपालको चियाबारीका लागि राष्ट्रियरूपमा प्रसिद्ध पूर्वी पहाडी जिल्ला कुन हो?
Explanation: Ilam District, in eastern Nepal, is nationally famous for its rolling tea gardens and tea production.

English Question: Which cave temple in Khotang district, sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, is dedicated to Lord Shiva?
Nepali Question: खोटाङ जिल्लाको, हिन्दू र बौद्ध दुवैका लागि पवित्र र भगवान शिवलाई समर्पित गुफा मन्दिर कुन हो?
Explanation: Halesi Mahadev, a natural cave temple in Khotang district, is sacred to both Hindus (as a Shiva shrine) and Buddhists (associated with Guru Rinpoche).

English Question: Which national park in Nepal's far-western Terai is known for protecting swamp deer and wild elephant herds?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सुदूरपश्चिम तराईमा रहेको, बाराहसिंगा र जंगली हात्तीको बथान संरक्षणका लागि प्रसिद्ध राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Shuklaphanta National Park, in the far-western Terai, is known for its large swamp deer population and herds of wild elephants.

English Question: Which national park lies just south of Chitwan National Park and forms part of a shared tiger conservation landscape?
Nepali Question: चितवन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्जको ठ्याक्कै दक्षिणमा रहेको र साझा बाघ संरक्षण क्षेत्रको हिस्सा बनेको राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Parsa National Park lies adjacent to Chitwan National Park's south, together forming a key connected landscape for tiger and wildlife conservation.

English Question: Which national park in eastern Nepal, surrounding the world's fifth-highest peak, protects one of the least disturbed river valleys in the Himalaya?
Nepali Question: विश्वको पाँचौं अग्लो हिमाल वरपर रहेको र हिमालयकै सबैभन्दा कम बिथोलिएको नदी उपत्यका संरक्षण गर्ने पूर्वी नेपालको राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Makalu Barun National Park, surrounding Mount Makalu in eastern Nepal, protects the Barun Valley, considered one of the least disturbed river valleys in the Himalaya.

English Question: Which national park just north of Kathmandu protects the watershed supplying much of the city's drinking water?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको उत्तरमा रहेको र शहरको धेरैजसो खानेपानीको स्रोत जलाधार क्षेत्र संरक्षण गर्ने राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, just north of Kathmandu, protects the watershed forest that supplies a significant portion of the city's drinking water.

English Question: Which remote national park in far-western Nepal is known for its high-altitude grasslands and medicinal herbs, with limited tourist visitation?
Nepali Question: सुदूरपश्चिम नेपालको, उच्च उचाइका घाँसे मैदान र जडिबुटीका लागि प्रसिद्ध तर पर्यटकको आगमन सीमित रहेको दुर्गम राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज कुन हो?
Explanation: Khaptad National Park, in far-western Nepal, is known for its high-altitude grasslands, medicinal herbs, and religious significance, with comparatively few visitors.

English Question: Which pilgrimage site at the confluence of the Sapta Koshi and Kokaha rivers in Sunsari district is sacred to Hindus?
Nepali Question: सुनसरी जिल्लामा सप्तकोशी र कोकाहा नदीको संगममा रहेको, हिन्दूहरूका लागि पवित्र तीर्थस्थल कुन हो?
Explanation: Barah Chhetra, at the confluence of the Sapta Koshi and Kokaha rivers in Sunsari district, is a sacred Hindu pilgrimage site associated with the Varaha (boar) incarnation of Vishnu.

English Question: What is the name of the tradition in which a young pre-pubescent girl is worshipped as a living goddess in the Kathmandu Valley?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा किशोरावस्था नपुगेकी बालिकालाई जीवित देवीको रूपमा पूजा गरिने परम्परालाई के भनिन्छ?
Explanation: The Kumari tradition involves worshipping a young pre-pubescent girl as a living manifestation of the goddess Taleju in the Kathmandu Valley.

English Question: What is the name of the historic open square adjoining Kathmandu Durbar Square, once a key trading point on the old trans-Himalayan trade route?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं दरबार क्षेत्रसँगै जोडिएको, पुरानो ट्रान्स-हिमालयी व्यापार मार्गको प्रमुख व्यापार बिन्दु रहेको ऐतिहासिक खुला चोकको नाम के हो?
Explanation: Basantapur, adjoining Kathmandu Durbar Square, was historically a key trading point along the old trans-Himalayan trade route between India and Tibet.

English Question: Which natural hot spring, a popular stop along the Araniko Highway near the Nepal-China border, is known for its therapeutic sulfur waters?
Nepali Question: अरनिको राजमार्गसँगै नेपाल-चीन सीमा नजिकैको, उपचारात्मक गन्धकयुक्त पानीका लागि प्रसिद्ध प्राकृतिक तातोपानी कुन हो?
Explanation: Tatopani, along the Araniko Highway near the Nepal-China border, is a popular natural hot spring known for its warm sulfur-rich waters believed to have therapeutic properties.

English Question: Which conservation area, established in 2010 in the Rolwaling Himal, lies between Sagarmatha and Langtang National Parks?
Nepali Question: रोल्वालिङ हिमालमा सन् २०१० मा स्थापना भएको, सगरमाथा र लाङटाङ राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्जको बीचमा रहेको संरक्षण क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: Gaurishankar Conservation Area, established in January 2010 and covering 2,179 sq km across Ramechhap, Dolakha, and Sindhupalchok districts, lies between Sagarmatha and Langtang National Parks.
Source Title: Nepal Tourism Board - Gaurishankar Conservation Area

English Question: Which is the smallest conservation area in Nepal, established in Bardiya district to protect an endangered antelope species?
Nepali Question: लोपोन्मुख मृग प्रजाति संरक्षणका लागि बर्दिया जिल्लामा स्थापना भएको, नेपालको सबैभन्दा सानो संरक्षण क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: The Blackbuck Conservation Area, also called Krishnasaar Conservation Area, covers just 16.95 sq km in Bardiya district and is Nepal's smallest protected area, established in 2009 to save the endangered blackbuck.
Source Title: Cross-checked: DNPWC-cited figures via multiple independent sources

English Question: Which was the first wetland in Nepal to be designated a Ramsar Site of International Importance, in 1987?
Nepali Question: सन् १९८७ मा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय महत्वको रामसार क्षेत्रको रूपमा घोषणा हुने नेपालको पहिलो सिमसार क्षेत्र कुन थियो?
Explanation: Koshi Tappu, declared on 17 December 1987, was Nepal's first Ramsar Site (Wetland of International Importance).

English Question: Which lake system in Kailali district, designated a Ramsar site in 2003, consists of about 13 shallow oxbow lakes and marshes?
Nepali Question: सन् २००३ मा रामसार क्षेत्रको रूपमा घोषणा भएको, करिब १३ वटा उथला अश्वखुर आकारका तालहरू र दलदल समेटेको कैलाली जिल्लाको ताल प्रणाली कुन हो?
Explanation: Ghodaghodi Lake Area, in Kailali district, was declared a Ramsar site on 13 August 2003 and consists of roughly 13 interconnected shallow lakes and marshes.

English Question: Which reservoir in Kapilvastu district, fed by the Banganga River, was designated a Ramsar site on the same day as Ghodaghodi Lake?
Nepali Question: बाणगंगा नदीबाट पानी पाउने र घोडाघोडी तालकै दिन रामसार क्षेत्रको रूपमा घोषणा भएको कपिलवस्तु जिल्लाको जलाशय कुन हो?
Explanation: Jagadishpur Reservoir in Kapilvastu district, fed by the Banganga River, was declared a Ramsar site on 13 August 2003, the same day as Ghodaghodi Lake.

English Question: Which Ramsar-listed oxbow lake near Chitwan National Park is a popular birdwatching site?
Nepali Question: चितवन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज नजिकैको, चरा हेर्नका लागि लोकप्रिय रामसार-सूचीकृत अश्वखुर आकारको ताल कुन हो?
Explanation: Beeshazar Tal, an oxbow lake near Chitwan National Park, is a Ramsar-listed wetland and one of Nepal's most popular birdwatching sites.

English Question: Which cluster of glacial lakes in Solukhumbu district, at about 5,000 meters, is both a trekking destination and a Ramsar site?
Nepali Question: सोलुखुम्बु जिल्लामा करिब ५,००० मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको, ट्रेकिङ गन्तव्य र रामसार क्षेत्र दुवै भएको हिमताल समूह कुन हो?
Explanation: The Gokyo Lakes, a cluster of glacial lakes in Solukhumbu at roughly 5,000 m, were designated a Ramsar site in September 2007 and are a popular Everest-region trekking destination.

English Question: Which small Ramsar-listed wetland in Ilam district, the last of Nepal's ten Ramsar sites to be designated (2008), is sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists?
Nepali Question: इलाम जिल्लाको, नेपालका दश रामसार क्षेत्रमध्ये अन्तिममा (२००८) घोषणा भएको र हिन्दू तथा बौद्ध दुवैका लागि पवित्र मानिने सानो सिमसार क्षेत्र कुन हो?
Explanation: Mai Pokhari, in Ilam district, was the last of Nepal's ten current Ramsar sites to be designated, on 28 October 2008, and holds religious significance for both Hindus and Buddhists.

English Question: Which historic high pass near Namche Bazaar was traditionally used by Sherpa and Tibetan traders to cross into Tibet?
Nepali Question: नाम्चे बजार नजिकैको, परम्परागत रूपमा शेर्पा र तिब्बती व्यापारीहरूले तिब्बत जान प्रयोग गर्ने ऐतिहासिक उच्च पास कुन हो?
Explanation: Nangpa La, near Namche Bazaar, was traditionally used by Sherpa and Tibetan traders as a trans-Himalayan trade route between Khumbu and Tibet.

English Question: Which high pass on the Everest Three Passes Trek, at approximately 5,360 meters, connects the Gokyo valley to Thame?
Nepali Question: एभरेष्ट थ्री पासेज ट्रेकको, करिब ५,३६० मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको र गोक्यो उपत्यकालाई थामेसँग जोड्ने उच्च पास कुन हो?
Explanation: Renjo La, at approximately 5,360 m, is one of the three high passes on the Everest Three Passes Trek, connecting the Gokyo valley to Thame.

English Question: Which high pass on the Everest Three Passes Trek, at approximately 5,420 meters, connects Dzongla to Thagnak near Gokyo?
Nepali Question: एभरेष्ट थ्री पासेज ट्रेकको, करिब ५,४२० मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको र जोङ्ग्लालाई गोक्यो नजिकैको थाग्नाकसँग जोड्ने उच्च पास कुन हो?
Explanation: Cho La, at approximately 5,420 m, is one of the three high passes on the Everest Three Passes Trek, linking Dzongla to Thagnak near Gokyo.

English Question: Which is the highest of the three passes on the Everest Three Passes Trek, at approximately 5,535 meters?
Nepali Question: एभरेष्ट थ्री पासेज ट्रेकका तीन पासमध्ये सबैभन्दा अग्लो, करिब ५,५३५ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको पास कुन हो?
Explanation: Kongma La, at approximately 5,535 m, is the highest of the three high passes on the Everest Three Passes Trek.

English Question: Which archaeological site near Lumbini, believed to be ancient Kapilvastu where Buddha spent his first 29 years, has been on UNESCO's tentative list since 1996?
Nepali Question: लुम्बिनी नजिकैको, बुद्धले आफ्नो सुरुका २९ वर्ष बिताएको प्राचीन कपिलवस्तु मानिने र सन् १९९६ देखि युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको पुरातात्विक स्थल कुन हो?
Explanation: Tilaurakot, believed to be the site of ancient Kapilvastu where Buddha spent his early life, has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 23 May 1996.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which stupa in Nawalparasi district, believed to contain undisturbed original relics of Buddha and left unopened even by Emperor Ashoka, is on UNESCO's tentative list?
Nepali Question: नवलपरासी जिल्लाको, बुद्धका मौलिक अवशेष अझै अछुतो रहेको र सम्राट अशोकले पनि नखोलेको भनिने युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको स्तूप कुन हो?
Explanation: Ramagrama, in Nawalparasi district, is believed to hold one of the original undisturbed relic deposits of Buddha; legend holds even Emperor Ashoka was prevented from opening it, and it has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 1996.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which historic Newar village south of Kathmandu, known for traditional mustard-oil production, is on UNESCO's tentative list?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको दक्षिणमा रहेको, परम्परागत तोरीको तेल उत्पादनका लागि प्रसिद्ध र युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको ऐतिहासिक नेवार गाउँ कुन हो?
Explanation: Khokana, a historic Newar village south of Kathmandu known for its traditional mustard-oil industry, has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 1996.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which walled city in Upper Mustang, former capital of the Kingdom of Lo, has been on UNESCO's tentative list since 2008?
Nepali Question: अपर मुस्ताङको पर्खाल-घेरिएको सहर, पूर्व लो राज्यको राजधानी, सन् २००८ देखि युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको छ, त्यो कुन हो?
Explanation: Lo Manthang, the walled former capital of the Kingdom of Lo in Upper Mustang, has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 30 January 2008.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which remote valley in Jumla district, once the seat of the medieval Khasa Malla kingdom, is on UNESCO's tentative list?
Nepali Question: जुम्ला जिल्लाको, मध्ययुगीन खस मल्ल राज्यको राजधानी रहेको र युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको दुर्गम उपत्यका कुन हो?
Explanation: Sinja Valley, in Jumla district, was once the capital of the medieval Khasa Malla kingdom and has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 2008.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which historic palace complex in Nuwakot district, associated with Prithvi Narayan Shah's unification campaign, is on UNESCO's tentative list?
Nepali Question: नुवाकोट जिल्लाको, पृथ्वीनारायण शाहको एकीकरण अभियानसँग सम्बन्धित र युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको ऐतिहासिक दरबार परिसर कुन हो?
Explanation: The Nuwakot Palace Complex, associated with King Prithvi Narayan Shah's campaign to unify Nepal, has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 2008.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which historic temple and settlement north of Kathmandu, dedicated to a tantric goddess, has been on UNESCO's tentative list since 2008?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको उत्तरमा रहेको, एक तान्त्रिक देवीलाई समर्पित र सन् २००८ देखि युनेस्को अस्थायी सूचीमा रहेको ऐतिहासिक मन्दिर तथा बस्ती कुन हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Vajrayogini Temple and Settlement of Sankhu
Explanation: The Vajrayogini Temple and early settlement of Sankhu, north of Kathmandu, dedicated to the tantric goddess Vajrayogini, has been on UNESCO's Tentative List since 2008.
Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which eastern Nepal river, a major tributary of the Koshi, shares its name with a hill district and forms part of the Kanchenjunga region's drainage?

English Question: Which tributary of the Koshi River flows past Mount Makalu and Mount Everest's eastern approach?
Nepali Question: माउन्ट मकालु र माउन्ट एभरेष्टको पूर्वी मार्ग हुँदै बग्ने, कोशी नदीको सहायक नदी कुन हो?

English Question: Which river, a major tributary of the Koshi system, flows past the Kathmandu-Kodari (Araniko Highway) route toward Tibet?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं-कोदारी (अरनिको राजमार्ग) मार्ग हुँदै तिब्बततिर बग्ने, कोशी प्रणालीको प्रमुख सहायक नदी कुन हो?

English Question: Which river, popular for whitewater rafting, flows near the Prithvi Highway between Kathmandu and Pokhara and joins the Gandaki system?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौं र पोखरा बीचको पृथ्वी राजमार्ग नजिकै बग्ने र गण्डकी प्रणालीमा मिसिने, ह्वाइटवाटर राफ्टिङका लागि लोकप्रिय नदी कुन हो?

English Question: Which river, originating near the Annapurna and Manaslu ranges, is popular for rafting near Pokhara and joins the Trishuli downstream?

English Question: Which river forms part of Nepal's far-western border with India and gives its name to a province?

English Question: Which city in Banke district, gateway to Bardiya National Park, is a major commercial hub in Nepal's mid-western Terai?

English Question: Which remote border point in Sankhuwasabha district, near Makalu Barun National Park, connects Nepal to Tibet in the far east?

English Question: Which mid-January Hindu festival, marking the sun's movement into Capricorn, is celebrated nationwide with sesame-sweet foods and is especially significant in Madhesh and hill regions?

Nepali Question: सामान्यतया डिसेम्बर-जनवरीतिर पर्ने, नेपालको गुरुङ समुदायले मनाउने नयाँ वर्ष चाड कुन हो?

English Question: Which pair of seasonal festivals, celebrated by the Kirat community (Rai and Limbu), mark the sowing and harvest seasons?

English Question: Which Newar festival, celebrated on the full moon of December, involves eating a steamed dumpling shaped like a fig and named after it?

English Question: Which striking peak near Everest, whose name means 'Mother's Necklace,' is a popular technical climbing objective though it is not an eight-thousander?
Nepali Question: एभरेष्ट नजिकैको, 'आमाको हार' भन्ने अर्थ बोक्ने र आठ हजार मिटर नपुगे पनि प्राविधिक आरोहणका लागि लोकप्रिय हिमाल कुन हो?

English Question: Which monastery in the Khumbu region, the largest in the area, hosts the annual Mani Rimdu masked-dance festival?

English Question: Which Hindu temple south of Kathmandu, dedicated to the goddess Kali, is known for its traditional animal sacrifices, especially on Saturdays?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको दक्षिणमा रहेको, देवी कालीलाई समर्पित र विशेषगरी शनिबार हुने परम्परागत पशुबलिका लागि प्रसिद्ध हिन्दू मन्दिर कुन हो?

English Question: Which temple north of Kathmandu features a large stone statue of a reclining Vishnu floating in a pond?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंको उत्तरमा रहेको, पोखरीमा पौडिरहेको जस्तो देखिने ठूलो ढुङ्गे शयन विष्णु मूर्ति भएको मन्दिर कुन हो?

English Question: Which popular trekking peak in the Everest region, near the Chukhung valley, is often climbed as an introduction to Himalayan mountaineering?
Nepali Question: एभरेष्ट क्षेत्रको चुखुङ उपत्यका नजिकैको, हिमाल आरोहणको परिचयको रूपमा प्रायः चढिने लोकप्रिय ट्रेकिङ शिखर कुन हो?

English Question: Which is the highest officially designated trekking peak in Nepal, at 6,476 meters, located in the Hinku Valley?
Nepali Question: हिन्कु उपत्यकामा रहेको, ६,४७६ मिटरको उचाइमा रहेको र नेपालको आधिकारिक रूपमा तोकिएको सबैभन्दा अग्लो ट्रेकिङ शिखर कुन हो?

English Question: Which is the smallest district in Nepal by area, located within Bagmati Province?

English Question: Which district in Nepal has the highest population, home to the national capital?

English Question: Which historic temple complex in Dailekh district of Karnali Province has been on UNESCO's tentative list since 2008?

Source Title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre - Tentative Lists (Nepal)

English Question: Which airstrip in Solukhumbu district, one of the world's most dangerous airports, is the standard air gateway for Everest region trekkers?
Nepali Question: सोलुखुम्बु जिल्लाको, विश्वकै खतरनाक विमानस्थलहरूमध्ये एक मानिने र एभरेष्ट क्षेत्रका ट्रेकरहरूको मानक हवाई प्रवेशद्वार रहेको विमानस्थल कुन हो?
