English Question: Which remote airstrip town, headquarters of Humla district, serves as a gateway for trekkers heading toward Mount Kailash via the Hilsa border crossing?
Nepali Question: हुम्ला जिल्लाको सदरमुकाम रहेको र हिल्सा सीमा नाकामार्फत कैलाश पर्वततर्फ जाने ट्रेकरहरूको प्रवेशद्वार बन्ने दुर्गम विमानस्थल शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Simikot, headquarters of Humla district, is a remote airstrip town serving as a common gateway for travelers heading toward Mount Kailash in Tibet via the Hilsa border crossing.

English Question: Which town in Rasuwa district, reachable by road from Kathmandu, is the standard starting point for the Langtang Valley trek?
Nepali Question: काठमाडौंबाट सडक मार्गबाट पुगिने, लाङटाङ उपत्यका ट्रेकको मानक सुरुवात बिन्दु रहेको रसुवा जिल्लाको शहर कुन हो?
Explanation: Syabrubesi, in Rasuwa district and reachable by road from Kathmandu, is the standard trailhead for the Langtang Valley trek.

English Question: In which year was the Constitution of Nepal promulgated?
Nepali Question: नेपालको संविधान कुन साल जारी भएको थियो?
Explanation: SAME underlying fact, but English sources overwhelmingly cite the Gregorian year (2015) while Nepali sources overwhelmingly cite the Bikram Sambat year (2072 BS). A model may answer '2015' in English and correctly convert it in Nepali (2072 BS is right), OR it may fail to convert and give '2015' written in Devanagari (wrong calendar, right number) when answering in Nepali - or vice versa, cite 2072 as if it were the AD year when answering in English. Test whether the model's TWO answers, when converted to a common calendar, actually refer to the same real-world date.
Source Title: Constitution of Nepal - Nepal Law Commission
Notes: RISK TYPE: calendar-system conversion drift (BS vs AD). Correct check: 2072 BS = 20 Sept 2015 - 2016 CE (BS new year falls mid-April, so 2072 BS spans parts of both 2015 and 2016 CE)

English Question: In which year did Nepal become a federal democratic republic?
Nepali Question: नेपाल कुन सालमा सङ्घीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र बन्यो?
Explanation: Same test pattern as XLANG001 - the republic declaration is universally cited as '2008' in English-language sources and as '2065 BS' in Nepali-language sources. A model should be able to correctly state either the AD or BS year on request, in EITHER input language, without conflating the two systems.
Source Title: Nepal profile - country history overview (cross-referenced with Wikipedia/Nepal government sources)
Notes: RISK TYPE: calendar-system conversion drift. Correct check: 2065 BS = 2008 CE (28 May 2008 falls within BS year 2065)

English Question: What was Nepal's population according to the most recent census?
Nepali Question: हालैको जनगणनाअनुसार नेपालको जनसंख्या कति थियो?
Gold Answer (NE): २,९१,६४,५७८ (नेपाली अङ्क प्रणालीमा: करिब २.९२ करोड अर्थात् २ करोड ९१ लाख ६४ हजार ५ सय ७८)
Explanation: SAME number, but English answers conventionally use the million/billion system while Nepali (and South Asian) answers conventionally use the lakh/crore system (1 crore = 10,000,000 = 1,00,00,000, NOT 1,000,000). This is a well-documented LLM weakness: models frequently misconvert between these two numbering systems - e.g., incorrectly stating '29.16 crore' (which would be 291.6 million, a 10x error) instead of the correct '2.92 crore'. Test whether the model's Nepali-language answer, when converted back to Western notation, actually equals its English-language answer.
Source Title: 2021 Nepal Census - Central Bureau of Statistics
Notes: RISK TYPE: numbering-system conversion drift (lakh/crore vs million/billion) - HIGH-VALUE test case, this is a widely documented category of LLM numerical hallucination

English Question: What is the height of the world's highest mountain, located on Nepal's border?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सीमामा रहेको विश्वको सबैभन्दा अग्लो हिमालको उचाइ कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): 8,848.86 meters - referred to as 'Mount Everest' in English
Explanation: SAME mountain, different names per language (Everest in English, Sagarmatha in Nepali, Qomolangma in Chinese/Tibetan). This tests whether a model correctly treats these as one entity with one height, or whether it risks giving a different (possibly outdated, e.g. old 8,848m) figure for one name versus the other - which would suggest the model has separately-drifted 'knowledge' associated with each name rather than a unified fact.
Source Title: It's official: Mount Everest is 8,848.86 metres tall - Kathmandu Post
Notes: RISK TYPE: same-entity-different-name drift. Also test whether model recognizes Everest=Sagarmatha=Qomolangma as one peak, not three

English Question: What is the current official name of the province that was formerly called 'Province No. 1'?
Nepali Question: पहिले 'प्रदेश नं. १' भनिने प्रदेशको हालको आधिकारिक नाम के हो?
Gold Answer (NE): कोशी प्रदेश (बि.सं. २०७९ फागुन १७ / सन् २०२३ मार्च १ मा नामकरण)
Explanation: This is a genuinely recent change (2023) and a strong test of whether a model's Nepali-language 'knowledge' has been updated at the same rate as its English-language knowledge. A common failure mode: the model may correctly give 'Koshi Province' in English (widely reported in English-language international coverage) but revert to the old numeric name 'प्रदेश नं. १' when answering in Nepali, or vice versa - since training data update rates can differ significantly by language.
Source Title: Province 1 Assembly endorses Koshi as the name of the province - Kathmandu Post
Notes: RISK TYPE: renamed-entity lag by language - HIGH VALUE, tests whether Nepali-language 'knowledge update lag' is worse than English for the same real-world event

English Question: How many districts are in Koshi Province?
Nepali Question: कोशी प्रदेशमा कति जिल्ला छन्?
Explanation: A subtler test than pure translation: does the model correctly associate the district count with the CURRENT name (Koshi Province) regardless of which language it's asked in, or does it get confused if it's still internally treating 'Province No. 1' (old name) and 'Koshi Province' (new name) as two different entities with potentially different associated facts?
Source Title: Districts of Koshi Province - cross-referenced administrative sources
Notes: RISK TYPE: renamed-entity fact-association drift, follow-up test to XLANG005

English Question: How much foreign exchange did Nepal earn from tourism, per WTTC's cited figure exceeding NPR 75 billion?
Nepali Question: WTTC ले उल्लेख गरेको रु. ७५ अर्बभन्दा बढीको तथ्याङ्कअनुसार, नेपालले पर्यटनबाट कति विदेशी मुद्रा आर्जन गर्यो?
Gold Answer (EN): Approximately NPR 75+ billion (English/Western: '$X million/billion' equivalent, depending on exchange rate used)
Explanation: Tests conversion consistency across THREE systems at once: Nepali 'अर्ब' (arba = 1 billion = 100 crore) vs. crore vs. Western billion/million - and whether the model correctly converts NPR to USD using a stated, reasonable exchange rate rather than an invented one. A model that gives inconsistent NPR-to-USD conversions between its English and Nepali answers is a strong hallucination signal.
Source Title: Tourism's Role in Nepal's GDP - Nepalytix (WTTC-cited figure)
Notes: RISK TYPE: multi-system numeral conversion drift (arba/crore vs million/billion, plus currency conversion) - complex, high-value test case

English Question: How many total provinces does Nepal have, and were they previously organized differently?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा कुल कति प्रदेश छन्, र यसअघि यिनको संगठन फरक थियो कि थिएन?
Gold Answer (EN): 7 provinces (established 2015 under federal restructuring); previously, Nepal was divided into 14 zones (अञ्चल) and 75 districts under the unitary system abolished in 2015.
Gold Answer (NE): ७ वटा प्रदेश (सन् २०१५ को सङ्घीय पुनर्संरचनाअन्तर्गत स्थापित); यसअघि नेपाल १४ अञ्चल र ७५ जिल्लामा विभाजित थियो, जुन एकात्मक प्रणाली सन् २०१५ मा खारेज गरियो।
Explanation: Tests whether a model conflates the abolished 'zone' (अञ्चल) system with the current 'province' (प्रदेश) system - a real risk especially in Nepali, where older training text discussing zones may be more prevalent than updated province-based text, potentially causing the model to describe an outdated administrative structure as current when answering in Nepali specifically.
Source Title: Constitution of Nepal (2015) - administrative restructuring, Nepal Law Commission
Notes: RISK TYPE: obsolete-system terminology bleed-through, language-asymmetric risk (old Nepali-language zone terminology may be overrepresented vs. English coverage of the same history)

English Question: How many national parks does Nepal have, and how is this number written out in full?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा कति राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज छन्, र यो सङ्ख्या पूरा गरी कसरी लेखिन्छ?
Explanation: A simple but genuine numeral-consistency check: does the model give the same digit (12) in both languages, and does it correctly spell out the Nepali word-form (बाह्र) rather than a mistranslated or garbled number word? Small numbers are lower-risk than large ones (see XLANG003, XLANG007) but still worth spot-checking as a baseline control.
Notes: RISK TYPE: baseline numeral-consistency control (low complexity, useful as a calibration/control item alongside the higher-risk large-number items)

English Question: In what year did Prithvi Narayan Shah begin Nepal's unification campaign, and what year is that in the Bikram Sambat calendar?
Nepali Question: पृथ्वीनारायण शाहले नेपाल एकीकरण अभियान कुन सालमा सुरु गरे, र विक्रम संवत्मा त्यो कुन साल हो?
Gold Answer (EN): 1743 CE, which corresponds to approximately 1800 BS
Gold Answer (NE): सन् १७४३, जुन बि.सं. लगभग १८०० सँग मिल्छ
Explanation: A direct test of bidirectional calendar conversion in a single question - asking the model to state a fact using both calendars and checking whether the AD-to-BS conversion (57-year offset, adjusted for the mid-April Nepali new year) is done correctly, rather than a rough or incorrect approximation being presented with false confidence.
Source Title: Unification of Nepal - cross-referenced historical sources
Notes: RISK TYPE: direct bidirectional calendar-conversion test within one question - use to check arithmetic consistency, not just recall

English Question: What is the name of Nepal's national flower, and how would you describe its color in each language?
Nepali Question: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूलको नाम के हो, र प्रत्येक भाषामा यसको रङ कसरी वर्णन गर्नुहुन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Rhododendron arboreum - English common description: red/pink/crimson flowering tree
Gold Answer (NE): लालीगुराँस - नेपालीमा सामान्यतया रातो रङको वर्णन गरिन्छ (यद्यपि यो सेतो र गुलाबी रङमा पनि पाइन्छ)
Explanation: Lower-risk translation-consistency check: does the model's description of the flower's typical color stay consistent across languages, or does emphasis shift (e.g., overstating 'always red' in one language when multiple color variants exist)? Useful as a softer test alongside the harder numeral/calendar items above.
Notes: RISK TYPE: descriptive-detail consistency (lower stakes than numeral/calendar items, included for variety of risk type)

English Question: What is the length of Nepal's longest river, the Karnali, and is this figure the same when the river is referred to only by its Nepali name?
Nepali Question: नेपालको सबैभन्दा लामो नदी कर्णालीको लम्बाइ कति हो, र यो नदीलाई नेपाली नाममा मात्र जनाउँदा पनि उही तथ्याङ्क आउँछ त?
Gold Answer (EN): Approximately 1,080 km (the Karnali does not have a separate widely-used English name distinct from its Nepali name, unlike Everest/Sagarmatha)
Gold Answer (NE): करिब १,०८० किलोमिटर (कर्णालीको छुट्टै व्यापक रूपमा प्रचलित अङ्ग्रेजी नाम छैन, एभरेष्ट/सगरमाथाको जस्तो)
Explanation: A control/contrast item: unlike XLANG004 (Everest/Sagarmatha), the Karnali has essentially one name across languages, so this tests whether the model's figure stays stable even without a name-translation variable in play - isolating whether drift in XLANG004-type items is specifically caused by the name change, not just general cross-language instability.
Notes: RISK TYPE: control item (no name-translation variable) - use alongside XLANG004 to isolate whether drift is name-driven or general

English Question: What percentage of Nepal's GDP does tourism contribute, and does the Nepali-language answer match the English-language answer when the same specific source is requested?
Nepali Question: नेपालको जीडीपीमा पर्यटनको योगदान कति प्रतिशत छ, र एउटै विशेष स्रोत मागिँदा नेपाली भाषाको उत्तर अङ्ग्रेजी भाषाको उत्तरसँग मिल्छ त?
Gold Answer (EN): Depends on which figure/source is specified (see DEB001 for the full range: 2.65% domestic-only per NSO, 6.7-7.9% total per WTTC, 1.7-2.1% direct-international per academic study) - the KEY test is whether the model cites the SAME figure for the SAME requested source in both languages, not whether one single figure is 'correct.'
Gold Answer (NE): स्रोतमा भर पर्छ (पूर्ण दायराका लागि DEB001 हेर्नुहोस्) - मुख्य जाँच यो हो कि एउटै तोकिएको स्रोतको लागि नेपाली र अङ्ग्रेजी दुवै भाषामा उही अङ्क आउँछ कि आउँदैन।
Explanation: This is a direct cross-reference to DEB001, reframed specifically as a language-consistency test rather than a source-disagreement test: given the SAME explicit source instruction (e.g., 'per WTTC'), does the model retrieve the same number in both languages, or does it drift to a different one of the several real figures depending on the query language?
Source Title: Nepal's domestic tourism contributes 2.65% to GDP - Republica (NSO-sourced), cross-referenced with WTTC figures
Notes: RISK TYPE: combines DEB001's source-ambiguity with a language-consistency test - use together with DEB001 for a fuller diagnostic

English Question: How many of the world's eight-thousand-meter mountains are located in Nepal, and are the same eight peaks named identically in both languages?
Nepali Question: विश्वका आठ हजार मिटरभन्दा माथिका हिमालहरूमध्ये कतिवटा नेपालमा छन्, र ती आठैवटा हिमालको नाम दुवै भाषामा उस्तै हो त?
Gold Answer (EN): 8 (Everest/Sagarmatha, Kanchenjunga, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu, Dhaulagiri, Manaslu, Annapurna I) - most names are shared across languages except Everest/Sagarmatha, which differ
Gold Answer (NE): ८ वटा (सगरमाथा/एभरेष्ट, कञ्चनजङ्घा, ल्होत्से, मकालु, चो ओयु, धौलागिरी, मनास्लु, अन्नपूर्ण १) - एभरेष्ट/सगरमाथाबाहेक अधिकांश नाम दुवै भाषामा उस्तै छन्
Explanation: Tests whether the model correctly identifies that ONLY Everest has a genuinely different common name in Nepali (Sagarmatha), while the other seven peaks are referred to by essentially the same name in both languages - a model that either invents alternate Nepali names for the other seven, or fails to recognize Everest/Sagarmatha as the same peak in a combined list, reveals inconsistent cross-language entity-linking.
Source Title: Cross-referenced list of Nepal's eight-thousanders (multiple sources, see original benchmark GEO009-GEO015)
Notes: RISK TYPE: entity-linking consistency across a multi-item list, not just a single fact - higher complexity test

English Question: In which month does the Dashain festival typically fall, and is the date given as a fixed Gregorian date or a lunar/Bikram Sambat-based date?
Nepali Question: दशैं चाड सामान्यतया कुन महिनामा पर्छ, र मिति ग्रेगोरियन पात्रोको स्थिर मिति हो कि चन्द्र/विक्रम संवत्मा आधारित मिति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): Dashain falls in September-October (Ashwin in the Nepali lunar calendar), but the exact Gregorian date shifts every year since it follows a lunar calendar - there is no single fixed Gregorian date.
Gold Answer (NE): दशैं असोज महिनामा (सेप्टेम्बर-अक्टोबर) पर्छ, तर यो चन्द्र पात्रोमा आधारित भएकाले ग्रेगोरियन मितिमा हरेक वर्ष फरक पर्छ - कुनै एउटा स्थिर ग्रेगोरियन मिति छैन।
Explanation: A model asked for Dashain's date in English might incorrectly state one fixed Gregorian date as if it recurred annually on that date (a real hallucination risk for any lunar-calendar-based festival), while a Nepali-language answer is more likely to correctly frame it by lunar month (Ashwin) without a fixed Gregorian date - testing whether the English answer over-specifies false precision that the Nepali answer correctly avoids.
Notes: RISK TYPE: false-precision risk asymmetry between languages for lunar-calendar-based events

English Question: What is the tourist visa-on-arrival fee for a British citizen staying in Nepal for 30 days?
Nepali Question: नेपालमा ३० दिन बस्ने बेलायती नागरिकको लागि आगमनमै पाइने पर्यटक भिसा शुल्क कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): USD 30 (30-day visa) - consistently cited across multiple current sources as of 2025-2026; payable in cash in USD or another major convertible currency (GBP, EUR accepted) at the entry point.
Gold Answer (NE): USD ३० (३० दिने भिसा) - सन् २०२५-२०२६ का धेरै हालसालैका स्रोतहरूमा एकरूपमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ; प्रवेश विन्दुमा नगदमा USD वा अन्य प्रमुख परिवर्तनीय मुद्रा (GBP, EUR) मा तिर्न मिल्छ।
Explanation: A basic but high-stakes practical fact for a real traveler - tests whether the model gives the same fee in NPR-equivalent terms (if it converts) or stays with the correct USD-denominated official figure in both languages, since the fee is officially set in USD, not NPR, and should not be 'translated' into a different currency system just because the question is in Nepali.
Source Title: Nepal Tourist Visa 2026 - On Arrival Fees - Holiday Maker Nepal
Source Type: Tourism industry reference (cross-checked against 6 independent sources)
Notes: Cross-checked consistently across thelongestwayhome.com, accessnepaltour.com, nepaltrekkingplanner.com, corporatenp.com, himalaya-discovery.com - all agree on USD 30/50/125 for 15/30/90 days

English Question: Why do Indian visitors not need a visa to enter Nepal, while a British visitor does?
Nepali Question: भारतीय पर्यटकलाई नेपाल प्रवेशका लागि भिसा किन चाहिँदैन, तर बेलायती पर्यटकलाई चाहिन्छ?
Gold Answer (EN): Indian nationals enter Nepal visa-free under the 1950 Indo-Nepal Treaty (a specific bilateral treaty, not a SAARC-wide policy) - British citizens are not covered by this treaty and must obtain a standard tourist visa.
Gold Answer (NE): भारतीय नागरिकहरू सन् १९५० को नेपाल-भारत सन्धि (एउटा विशेष द्विपक्षीय सन्धि, SAARC-व्यापी नीति होइन) अन्तर्गत नेपालमा भिसा बिना प्रवेश गर्छन् - बेलायती नागरिकहरू यो सन्धिमा समावेश छैनन् र मानक पर्यटक भिसा चाहिन्छ।
Explanation: A causal/explanatory question testing whether the model correctly attributes India's visa-free status to the specific 1950 bilateral treaty, rather than incorrectly generalizing it as a broader 'South Asian neighbor' or SAARC-wide exemption that would misleadingly imply other SAARC nations (or a British visitor) might also qualify for similar treatment.
Source Title: Nepal Tourist Visa Information - The Longest Way Home
Notes: RISK TYPE: causal-explanation accuracy - tests whether model correctly cites treaty basis rather than a generic regional-neighbor explanation

English Question: Does a British trekker still need to obtain a TIMS card to trek to Everest Base Camp in 2025?
Nepali Question: सन् २०२५ मा एभरेष्ट बेस क्याम्प ट्रेक गर्न बेलायती ट्रेकरलाई अझै TIMS कार्ड चाहिन्छ त?
Gold Answer (EN): No, as of 2025 the TIMS card is no longer mandatory for the Everest Base Camp/Khumbu region - it has been effectively replaced by the mandatory Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Entry Permit (NPR 2,000); TIMS remains optional if a trekker chooses to still obtain one.
Gold Answer (NE): होइन, सन् २०२५ देखि एभरेष्ट बेस क्याम्प/खुम्बु क्षेत्रका लागि TIMS कार्ड अनिवार्य छैन - यसलाई अनिवार्य खुम्बु पासाङ ल्हामु गाउँपालिका प्रवेश अनुमतिपत्र (रु. २,०००) ले प्रभावकारी रूपमा प्रतिस्थापन गरेको छ; ट्रेकरले चाहेमा अझै वैकल्पिक रूपमा TIMS लिन सक्छन्।
Explanation: This is a genuine recency trap: many English-language trekking websites (including older cached content) still describe TIMS as mandatory for this specific region, even though the rule changed. Tests whether a model's answer reflects the current 2025 rule consistently in both languages, or whether one language version lags behind with outdated information.
Source Title: Everest Base Camp Trek Permit - Rules, Permit Cost 2025-2026 - Abound Holidays
Notes: RISK TYPE: recency/rule-change trap - directly relevant to your original hallucination-typology RQ4, cross-checked against himalayanrecreation.com and bestheritagetour.com

English Question: When and where must a British trekker pay the Sagarmatha National Park entry fee - in advance online, or on the trail?
Nepali Question: बेलायती ट्रेकरले सगरमाथा राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज प्रवेश शुल्क कहिले र कहाँ तिर्नुपर्छ - अगावै अनलाइन, वा बाटोमै?
Gold Answer (EN): The permit is obtained either at the Nepal Tourism Board office in Kathmandu before departure, or directly at the park entrance checkpoint in Monjo along the trekking route - not something paid purely 'online in advance' with no physical checkpoint step.
Gold Answer (NE): यो अनुमतिपत्र या त काठमाडौंको नेपाल पर्यटन बोर्ड कार्यालयबाट प्रस्थान अघि, वा ट्रेकिङ मार्गमा रहेको मोन्जोको निकुञ्ज प्रवेश चेकपोस्टबाट सिधै लिन सकिन्छ - यो पूर्णतया 'अनलाइन अगावै' मात्र तिर्ने कुरा होइन, भौतिक चेकपोस्ट चरण चाहिन्छ।
Explanation: Tests whether the model correctly describes the two legitimate real-world collection points (NTB Kathmandu office, or Monjo checkpoint) rather than inventing a purely online payment system that doesn't reflect the actual physical permit process - a practical detail a real British trekker would need to get right before travel.
Source Title: How to Obtain Everest Base Camp Trek Permits and Fees - Himalayan Recreation
Notes: RISK TYPE: practical-process accuracy - tests whether model invents a simplified/incorrect payment mechanism

English Question: Who qualifies for the discounted SAARC rate on the Annapurna Conservation Area Permit, and does a British citizen qualify?
Nepali Question: अन्नपूर्ण संरक्षण क्षेत्र अनुमतिपत्रमा छुट पाउने SAARC दरका लागि को योग्य हुन्छ, र बेलायती नागरिक योग्य हुन्छ त?
Gold Answer (EN): SAARC member-country nationals (e.g., India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Maldives, Pakistan, Afghanistan) pay USD 10; a British citizen, as a non-SAARC national, does not qualify for this rate and pays the standard foreigner rate of USD 30.
Gold Answer (NE): SAARC सदस्य राष्ट्रका नागरिकहरू (जस्तै भारत, बङ्गलादेश, श्रीलंका, भुटान, माल्दिभ्स, पाकिस्तान, अफगानिस्तान) ले USD १० तिर्छन्; बेलायती नागरिक, गैर-SAARC नागरिकको हैसियतले, यो दरका लागि योग्य हुँदैन र मानक विदेशी दर USD ३० तिर्नुपर्छ।
Explanation: Tests whether the model correctly identifies the UK as NOT a SAARC member (a factual eligibility check, not just a fee lookup) - a model might incorrectly assume any 'foreign discount' applies broadly, when in fact this specific discount is nationality-restricted to a defined regional bloc that excludes the UK.
Source Title: Nepal Trekking Permits Guide 2025 - Nepal Vision Treks
Notes: RISK TYPE: eligibility-category accuracy, not just fee recall - tests whether model correctly excludes UK from SAARC-linked benefits

English Question: Where in Nepal must a British tourist obtain a Restricted Area Permit before trekking in Upper Mustang, and how much does it cost per day?
Nepali Question: बेलायती पर्यटकले अपर मुस्ताङमा ट्रेक गर्नुअघि नेपालको कुन ठाउँबाट प्रतिबन्धित क्षेत्र अनुमतिपत्र लिनुपर्छ, र यसको दैनिक शुल्क कति हो?
Gold Answer (EN): The Restricted Area Permit (RAP) for Upper Mustang is obtained through a registered trekking agency (a licensed guide is mandatory for restricted areas), typically arranged via Nepal Tourism Board channels in Kathmandu or Pokhara; the cost is USD 500 for the first 10 days.
Gold Answer (NE): अपर मुस्ताङको प्रतिबन्धित क्षेत्र अनुमतिपत्र (RAP) दर्ता भएको ट्रेकिङ एजेन्सीमार्फत लिइन्छ (प्रतिबन्धित क्षेत्रका लागि इजाजतप्राप्त गाइड अनिवार्य हुन्छ), सामान्यतया काठमाडौं वा पोखराको नेपाल पर्यटन बोर्ड च्यानलमार्फत मिलाइन्छ; लागत पहिलो १० दिनका लागि USD ५०० हो।
Explanation: Tests two facts together: the process (mandatory guide/agency involvement, since Upper Mustang is a restricted area unlike open trekking routes) and the fee (USD 500/10 days) - a common error would be a model omitting the mandatory-guide requirement specific to restricted areas, treating it the same as an open trekking region.
Source Title: Nepal Trekking Permits Guide 2025 - Nepal Vision Treks
Notes: RISK TYPE: process + fee compound accuracy check - restricted-area rules differ meaningfully from open-trekking-region rules

English Question: How should a British tourist pay the Nepal visa-on-arrival fee - by credit card, or in cash?
Nepali Question: बेलायती पर्यटकले नेपालको आगमन भिसा शुल्क कसरी तिर्नुपर्छ - क्रेडिट कार्डबाट, वा नगदमा?
Gold Answer (EN): In cash - fresh, undamaged banknotes in USD (or another major convertible currency such as GBP or EUR) are required at the payment counter; card payment is generally not reliable or standard for this specific fee at the border/airport counter.
Gold Answer (NE): नगदमा - भुक्तानी काउन्टरमा नयाँ, नबिग्रिएको USD नोट (वा GBP, EUR जस्ता अन्य प्रमुख परिवर्तनीय मुद्रा) चाहिन्छ; यो विशेष शुल्कका लागि सीमा/विमानस्थल काउन्टरमा कार्ड भुक्तानी सामान्यतया भरपर्दो वा मानक हुँदैन।
Explanation: A practical detail with real consequences for a traveler - tests whether the model gives consistent, accurate payment-method guidance rather than assuming modern card-payment infrastructure that may not reliably apply at this specific government counter, and whether it notes the 'fresh/undamaged notes' requirement consistently.
Source Title: Nepal Tourist Visa 2026 - On Arrival Fees - Holiday Maker Nepal
Notes: RISK TYPE: practical payment-method accuracy - tests whether model assumes modern infrastructure incorrectly

English Question: How long can a British tourist stay in Nepal across a calendar year using visa extensions, at maximum?
Nepali Question: बेलायती पर्यटक भिसा नवीकरण गरेर एक क्यालेन्डर वर्षमा बढीमा कति समय नेपालमा बस्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer (EN): A maximum cumulative total of 150 days per calendar year (January-December), regardless of how the stay is split across multiple visits or extensions within that year.
Gold Answer (NE): एक क्यालेन्डर वर्ष (जनवरी-डिसेम्बर) मा बढीमा जम्मा १५० दिनसम्म, चाहे त्यो बसाइ त्यो वर्षभित्र धेरै पटकको भ्रमण वा नवीकरणमा विभाजित भए पनि।
Explanation: Tests a cumulative-limit rule (150 days/year) rather than a simpler single-visa-duration fact - a model might correctly state individual visa lengths (15/30/90 days) but fail to also mention the separate, overarching 150-day annual cap that applies across all visits combined.
Source Title: How to Get Nepal Tourist Visa in 2026 - AccessNepalTour
Notes: RISK TYPE: compound-rule accuracy (individual visa length vs. separate annual cumulative cap) - cross-checked against corporatenp.com and holidaymakernepal.com

English Question: What is the total cost in Nepalese Rupees of the mandatory permits for a British trekker doing the Everest Base Camp trek in 2025?
